title: Thresholds of singularities in characteristic zero
summary: We study properties of characteristic zero variants of Frobenius thresholds $c^J(\mathfrak a)$ inspired by the work of Epstein-McDonald-R.G. and the second author. Suppose $R$ is an excellent domain of equal characteristic zero with a dualizing complex and $\mathfrak a, J \subseteq R$ are nonzero ideals with $\mathfrak a \subseteq \sqrt{J}$. By using a log resolution of singularities $Y$ of $(R, \mathfrak a)$ as well as the derived global sections of a line bundle on $Y$, we construct two analogs of the Frobenius threshold, the Hironaka-threshold and the Koszul-Hironaka threshold.
